mapper.select: SELECT book_ref_id, book_key FROM textbook_ref_aliases WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_key_hash = #{bookKeyHash}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO textbook_ref_aliases (user_id, book_key_hash, book_key, book_ref_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookKeyHash}, #{bookKey}, #{bookRefId})
mapper.update: UPDATE textbook_ref_aliases SET book_ref_id = #{toRefId} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_ref_id = #{fromRefId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM textbook_refs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_ref_id = #{bookRefId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_events WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (object_ref LIKE CONCAT(#{refPrefix}, '%') OR payload LIKE CONCAT('%"', #{refPrefix}, '%'))

SELECT user_id, course_id, textbook_title, textbook_isbn, textbook_edition FROM courses WHERE (textbook_title IS NOT NULL AND textbook_title <> '') OR (textbook_isbn IS NOT NULL AND textbook_isbn <> '') ORDER BY user_id, course_id

SELECT DISTINCT user_id, source_textbook_key AS book_key FROM course_topics WHERE source_textbook_key IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT DISTINCT user_id, textbook_toc_book_key AS book_key FROM courses WHERE textbook_toc_book_key IS NOT NULL ORDER BY user_id
